_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: In a confirmed coil with 3% directional hit rate over 7 days, the skilled call is HOLD at Panic until either ETF flows turn positive or VIX breaks above 70 to force the next leg.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst leans HOLD with medium conviction citing coil statistics; narrative implies upward resolution via accumulation analogy but does not explicitly call direction
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive AND MVRV z-score recovers above 30 with BTC momentum holding above 45
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 70 with funding spiking above 0.01% and BTC momentum rolling over below 40
